E0 I0006 KILLED - the highest-stakes screen of the batch, and the most valuable, because it ran a PLACEBO. Real absence-game top-1-absorber share of vacated usage: 0.470 (n=578). Placebo noise floor on ordinary presence games with no absence: 0.539 (n=200). THE PLACEBO IS MORE CONCENTRATED THAN THE REAL EFFECT, so apparent concentration is an artifact of ordinary game-to-game usage variance rather than any response to the absence. Without the placebo the headline would have read '47 percent of vacated usage goes to a single teammate', which sounds like a finding and is worthless. Any future screen measuring concentration, redistribution or response-to-an-event must carry a placebo or it is uninterpretable. THE USER'S GUARD WAS DECISIVE AND HONOURED: all four conditional cuts were run (starter vs bench, position, 12 teams as coach proxy, 1 vs 2+ simultaneous absences); all land within noise, and team means cluster at std 0.017 against a pooled per-game std of 0.131, showing no coach-specific structure. The kill therefore rests on conditional evidence, not a pooled average. SCOPE OF THE KILL: it kills the hypothesis that vacated usage concentrates in a PREDICTABLE ABSORBER. It does NOT kill minutes/exposure projection generally - this measured usage SHARE with a crude DNP proxy at n=578, and redistribution could still be patterned in minutes or predictable by untested means. Do not let it become 'exposure modelling is impossible'. T2 layer 4 remains VIABLE_BUT_UNVALIDATED. head: 374fce9896be87ef4778e8a6d7fe15f6d9fce6ea
detail: TWO RETURNS CLOSED, BOTH VERIFIED ON BYTES. Decisions D078 and D079. D078 - F1 MEASURED AND THE COORDINATOR'S OWN D075 IS CORRECTED ON TWO POINTS. M13's calibration verdict SURVIVES an honest time-ordered fit in all four variants; the entire correction is 7.7% of M13's own CI95 width; M14 was re-run five times and its largest move is 0.8% of ITS CI width with the verdict unchanged. DIRECTION CORRECTED, AND THIS ONE IS THE COORDINATOR'S OWN ERROR: the audit's `direction` field asserted the leak flattered the model, the coordinator REPEATED that unprobed inference in D075 and in the measurement brief, and the measurement shows THE OPPOSITE - the honest fit is BETTER and TIGHTER, because pooling the future produces a tighter scale and more confident probabilities are punished in a model that discriminates poorly. The leak flattered the LIKELIHOOD while hurting the CALIBRATION SCORE. REMEDIATION REMAINS USER-GATED (two passed nodes, GRAPH_POLICY 6). Coordinator RECOMMENDS annotate + fix-forward rather than re-running, and records that the measured magnitude is a LOWER BOUND because the mildest honest re-specification was used. Attempts: 88.1% of the conditional increment retained end-to-end with nothing realised anywhere (dR2 0.016853 vs 0.019139), family-wise p 0.0002. The base R2 COLLAPSES 0.5110 -> 0.3135 but the INCREMENT DOES NOT - the mix term is near-orthogonal to attempts-forecast error, and a degradation curve shows even a ZERO-INFORMATION attempts forecast retains 85%. A volume placebo on total attempts gives -0.000309, so it is a genuine mix signal. No volume of data rescues it. This DISCHARGES the coordinator's own D074 ruling 3 - and the answer is that the attempts forecast was never the threat; the response variable's scale was. Reproduction 0.000e+00 TWICE, independently, including a full raw-file rebuild. head: 16a16d7aa51d150543dbeaf9935377810b16761e

head: ac56ce7c94e4508a7755e52580aad3ed995b3edf
detail: E0_I0015_points_skill_decomposition RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D081. WHERE THE POINTS SKILL IS LOST: at the per-minute EFFICIENCY step for established players, AND destroyed outright on cold-start rows. The pooled -0.22% is a NEAR-CANCELLATION of a large negative on a small stratum against a modest positive on a large one - not a uniform absence of skill. NO COMPONENT GOES TO ZERO, so 'rates are pure noise' and 'the model forecasts rates worse than a prior mean' are BOTH REJECTED. The loss is compositional. THE MOST IMPORTANT PROCESS EVENT OF THE SESSION: the agent DRAFTED the headline 'the minutes forecast destroys value' - which the pooled 2x2 supports at p .0005 in every season - and then WITHDREW IT after stratifying, because the ordering REVERSES on established players (H1 +1.44% beats H3 +0.33%) and the entire pooled result is produced by 1,061 fallback rows scoring -18.6%. Preserved as `pooled_verdict_WITHDRAWN` rather than deleted. A pooled statistic inverted by a 7% stratum is exactly what GRAPH_POLICY 13.5 was written about. THE DECISION-RELEVANT STRATUM - >=8 prior appearances and >=24 minutes, 37% of rows, the players anyone would actually bet on - has points skill -0.36% at p 0.27. Minutes skill there is +7.7% and buys NOTHING, because points error is dominated ~3:1 by efficiency (perfect rate cuts MAE 58.5%, perfect minutes 18.4%). CEILING: 51.3% of points variance is irreducible even to an oracle knowing identity AND realised minutes - BUT a pre-game-reachable oracle reaches R2 0.3844 vs the champion's 0.3085, leaving ~0.076 R2 uncaptured. BOTH HALVES TRUE. CHEAPEST IDENTIFIED IMPROVEMENT IN THE PROGRAM, RECORDED NOT ENACTED: splicing the running mean where prior appearances <3 (7.2% of rows, no new data, no refit) moves pooled points skill from -0.22% to +1.36% at p 0.0010. The cold-start deficit is a MODEL effect, not an intrinsic limit. No fitting was authorised, so this is left for the user. BOUNDS D076: nothing pre-game predicts differential skill on efficiency - 0 of 110 points cells and 0 of 330 rate cells clear family-wise. The abstention rule is a MINUTES rule and does NOT generalise to points. DEFECT FOUND IN THE KIT ADOPTED AT D077, AND THE COORDINATOR REPRODUCED IT BY RUNNING KIT_BUG_REPRO.py: detect_grouping_level CRASHES on any BOOLEAN feature (bool passes is_numeric_dtype, then max-min on numpy bools raises TypeError), and permutation_null inherits it. The 49-test suite missed it because it never exercises a boolean. TWO OF D076's FOUR SURVIVING LEADS ARE BOOLEANS. A crash is the SAFE failure mode. THE MORE SERIOUS FINDING IS A DESIGN ISSUE, NOT THE CRASH: detect_grouping_level returns `recommended_permutation_level: 'row'` for row-varying features - the kit RECOMMENDING THE ANTICONSERVATIVE NULL, silently, with its own authority. That is the exact error the kit exists to prevent. Also found: a name collision (screenkit.r2_plain REFITS OLS while the screens' r2_plain scores a given forecast) that caused a false reproduction alarm, and no paired-comparison machinery. D077's preserved_disagreement predicted precisely this and is VINDICATED. Asking the first user to REPORT defects rather than work around them is ratified as standing practice. Fix dispatched.

head: 56dc793a570adc2e4b19e73b13e9eb2c0ff7ca69
detail: INFRASTRUCTURE EVENT, NOT A FINDING. Decision D083. The E1_I0004_efficiency_transfer agent was killed mid-run by an API error ('Connection closed mid-response') after ~14 minutes. PER GRAPH_POLICY 12 ITS WORK IS UNCLAIMED AND UNUSABLE. Nothing from it enters the ledger, the idea log, or any ranking. THE PARTIAL WORK WAS ESPECIALLY DANGEROUS BECAUSE IT LOOKS FINISHED: a 34 KB FINDINGS.json, three contrast CSVs and a 7.5 MB permutation-draws file, all present. But the agent's final transmission was 'The uncentred allowance is a level shift, not a cross-sectional signal - I need to fix that before computing any contrast' - i.e. IT WAS REPORTING THAT THE CONSTRUCTION UNDER EVERY CONTRAST THERE IS WRONG AND UNFIXED. The artifacts embody the PRE-FIX construction. QUARANTINED IN PLACE, NOT DELETED: an ABANDONED.md marker names the failure, quotes the warning, and states which files may be read as scaffolding and which may never be reused. Deleting would remove evidence; leaving it unmarked would leave a trap. RETRIED AT THE SAME TIER as E1_I0004_efficiency_transfer_v2, with the inherited defect stated as a design requirement - GRAPH_POLICY 12 forbids retrying cheaper. Independent work (E0_I0016_efficiency_predictors) continued unaffected; the lane did not stall. THE METHODOLOGICAL POINT IS CARRIED FORWARD RATHER THAN REDISCOVERED: an uncentred opponent allowance is a LEVEL SHIFT, not a cross-sectional signal, and must be centred against the point-in-time league mean. This is the same distinction as D080's season-level scalar anchor - harmless cross-sectionally, not harmless for level claims - reached independently by two agents from opposite directions. Carried as a DESIGN CONSIDERATION, explicitly NOT as a finding claimed from unusable output. PROCESS IMPROVEMENT ADDED TO THE RETRY BRIEF: write per-step results to disk incrementally, and write any self-identified defect to disk IMMEDIATELY rather than holding it for the final message. The dead agent's most valuable output was a warning that survived only as a captured fragment of its last transmission - too thin a thread.

head: 9d6e10eb9fb5f681b91262b453fc9035446592fe
detail: E1_I0004_efficiency_transfer_v2 RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D084. VERDICT: KILL. The centred conversion signal HELPS NOWHERE: on-stratum dR2 -0.000556 (p 0.2535, whole-cluster sign-flip at opponent-team-season), off-stratum -0.000639 (p 0.2563). Sign NEGATIVE in both. THE ARITHMETIC CEILING CLOSES IT: 1 sd of the centred signal moves points by 0.0859 against a response sd of 7.5505, capping a PERFECT orthogonal predictor at dR2 <= 0.000129 - EIGHT-POINT-SEVEN TIMES SMALLER than the 0.001127 ceiling that already killed shot-mix at D079. Oracle bound with full-hindsight rescaling is 3.87e-05, so it is not a mis-scaled coefficient. THE COORDINATOR'S REASONING WAS RIGHT AND THE ANSWER STILL NEGATIVE: D079's mix ceiling genuinely does not transfer (converting is not reallocating), so conversion needed its own ceiling - and its own came out smaller, because the opponent's cross-sectional spread in rim-conversion allowance is tiny by the time it reaches player-game points. THIS VINDICATES D083's QUARANTINE, STARKLY. OC_RA has mean +0.1886 against sd 0.0380 - the mean is 5.0x its own sd, so uncentred it is overwhelmingly a constant. Uncentred, on-stratum per-minute dR2 is -0.009234 (16x worse), and on POINTS it is -0.008063 AT p 0.0042 - READING AS SIGNIFICANT, IN THE WRONG DIRECTION, ENTIRELY AS AN ARTEFACT. Anyone who had trusted the abandoned FINDINGS.json would have read that artefact as a result. Centring preserves cross-sectional ordering: corr(OC, OCc) = 0.9893. REPRODUCTION EXACT: 0.000e+00 on D074's slope, 0.000e+00 on the opponent construction REBUILT FROM RAW SHOTS, 0.000e+00 on all seven D081 stratum values. head: 3b459dc52c68a84e1535906644a5a4685d21f659

head: ecb3c6ea657bd63e4d245debd5c54d7a47475471
detail: E0_I0017_shot_quality_efficiency RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D087. THE PROGRAM'S CENTRAL QUESTION IS ANSWERED IN THE NEGATIVE. STEP 0 PROVENANCE GATE RESOLVED ON VALUES: data/shotcharts/* is ROW-granular. Decisive evidence - SHOT_DISTANCE is reproducible from that same row's LOC_X/LOC_Y on 1.000000 of 132,558 rows, a WITHIN-ROW derivation that cannot encode any other row. The D086 invariant worked on its first outing: exactly one column NOMINATED by name (PERIOD, contains 'per'), ZERO convicted. The agent did NOT launder the manifest status - check_manifest still returns UNVERIFIABLE and it says so, resolving this file without weakening the general rule. ANSWER: 0 OF 39 ppm cells clear family-wise against a base holding the player's own prior ppm, TS and eFG. On the D081 decision stratum NOT ONE candidate clears even per-candidate (min p 0.150). THE AGENT KILLED ITS OWN HEADLINE: D04 was the only ppm cell to clear family-wise at dR2 0.009597 - a ~1% R2 increment on exactly the hunted quantity - and it is an artifact. With the full reference in the base it collapses to 0.000107 at family-wise p 1.0. COORDINATOR'S INTERNAL CORROBORATION: under that base D04 and D01 converge to the SAME dR2 to fifteen decimals, which is what MUST happen if D04 is D01 minus the reference. A NEW TRAP SHAPE IS RECORDED - REFERENCE INCOMPLETENESS. Nothing reads the future; the null is correct; the effect is real but NOT INCREMENTAL, because the reference measured prior efficiency one way while the candidate smuggled in a second measurement of the same quantity. IT PASSES EVERY EXISTING GUARD - the leakage probe, the entity-swap null, and the correct-level permutation null at p 0.0017. ONLY DECOMPOSITION CAUGHT IT. Decomposition is adopted as a STANDING step. FIRST MECHANISTIC EXPLANATION OF WHY EFFICIENCY DOES NOT REACH POINTS: shot quality genuinely predicts CONVERSION (37 of 78 eFG/TS cells family-wise, 55 of 60 season-pairs sign-consistent, surviving the decision stratum) but 12 OF 12 candidates show OPPOSING SIGNS on eFG versus shots-per-minute - closer shots convert better and yield fewer attempts. A VOLUME OFFSET, netting 0.41 points/game before multiplicity. THE OPPONENT-DEFENCE SURFACE IS NOW CLOSED FROM THREE DIRECTIONS: assisted share 0 of 15, opponent shot-quality-conceded 0 of 18, plus D084's conversion ceiling and D085's twelve outcome-based constructions. FOUR SCREENS AND ~1,000 CELLS AGAINST THE EFFICIENCY STEP WITH NO SURVIVOR. Recommendation to the user: consolidate on the minutes-and-abstention work (D076's abstention rule, D081's cold-start splice) - both user decisions. KIT: NO behavioural defects from the fourth user - the first clean run since adoption. entity_swap_null, ported at D086 because a second screen needed it, PAID FOR ITSELF IMMEDIATELY: all 39 candidates returned NO_COARSER_LEVEL and it removed the very incentive that created D085's error.

head: 38ee457f3d62064f37b37d1d329f7bda39f1e488
detail: FORECAST TARGET INVENTORY SETTLED ON BYTES. Decision D088. It has NEVER been residual-characterised, and it is directly complementary to D076's abstention rule - that rule declines to forecast thin-sample players, while p_active forecasts whether a player appears at all. Screening it is ungated and is being dispatched. THE COORDINATOR COMMITTED THE NAME-BASED FALSE-HIT TRAP ITSELF, HOURS AFTER ADOPTING THE INVARIANT AGAINST IT. THIS ONE WAS IN A THROWAWAY SCRIPT - precisely where discipline gets dropped and where a wrong answer would be believed because nobody audits a quick check. The invariant is a REASONING standard, not a code-review standard, and binds ad-hoc checks equally.
