head: 655a124c3ddc822bcfd219c98fac033ad8b9ffe7
detail: E1_I0018_teammate_volume_channel RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D089. VERDICT: SPLIT. THIS IS NOW THE PROGRAM'S BEST USABLE LEAD. COORDINATOR CORRECTION FIRST: the coordinator told the user this feature needed 'tip-time box membership' and would be usable close to tip-off. THAT UNDERSTATED THE CONSTRAINT. PRESENT(g) is `minutes > 0` in TODAY'S box - strictly stronger than the active list, since DNP-CD, blowout, warm-up injury and ejection all remove a player. IT IS A POST-GAME OBSERVATION and a perfect pre-game report yields only a superset. The tip-time variant is IMPOSSIBLE pre-game, not merely late. THE USABLE RESULT: P01_c04_prevgame - previous game's box, NO same-day information - gives a WALK-FORWARD paired points dR2 of 0.002349 at cluster p 0.0345 on the decision stratum against a COMPLETE own-prior reference, and clears family-wise on shots-per-minute on both strata (fw 0.0116). It FAILS family-wise on points-per-minute (fw 0.0815 decision), which is why the verdict is SPLIT rather than a clean keep. CHANNEL MEASURED, NOT INFERRED: decision stratum, shots-per-minute 0.007987 (fw 0.0017) > points-per-minute 0.004963 > points-per-shot 0.000062 (fw 1.0). Identities verified: y_ppm = y_spm * y_pps to 1.8e-15. THE CEILING IS THE LARGEST THE PROGRAM HAS MEASURED: prior-only <= 0.002057, tip-time <= 0.003689, against D079's mix ceiling of 0.001127 and D084's conversion ceiling of 0.000129 - roughly 1.8x and 16x for the usable variant. D087's VOLUME-OFFSET DOES NOT APPLY: there is no conversion arm to cancel against, and 93% of the movement travels through shots. MECHANISM WITH ITS SIGN REGISTERED IN ADVANCE: usage redistribution, not shot creation - negative in 16 of 16 cells; when high-usage teammates are absent the remaining player shoots more. p10-p90: -1.52 shots and -1.88 points per game. 49.2% OF THE CHANNEL IS SAME-DAY NEWS. The prior-only variant retains a median 39.9% of the tip-time effect, and the pure news increment clears family-wise on its own - so the gap is real signal nobody can have in advance. A GENUINE PRE-GAME INJURY FEED IS NOW THE HIGHEST-VALUE DATA ACQUISITION THE PROGRAM HAS IDENTIFIED, and it is an acquisition question for the user, same shape as D071's historical totals. DISCIPLINE: candidate list hashed and frozen before any statistic, 0 added after seeing results. 154 cells in one family-wise max-t: 64 clear family-wise, and 98 WOULD have cleared on the naive row null - NINTH confirmation of the wrong-null trap. The agent's pre-registered mechanism prediction was HALF RIGHT and it kept it. KIT: NO defects, second consecutive clean run. THREE POSITIVE CONFIRMATIONS: the K2 entity-swap port reproduced D085's p_N2 EXACTLY on real data; K0's date value-gate correctly skipped a `season_type` column in the wild; the r2_of_forecast/r2_plain split was needed and unambiguous.

head: 5c0e852f26a1da76ad544096f7d45522e27737c7
detail: E0_I0019_availability_forecast RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D090. PROVENANCE ESTABLISHED with five leak probes, the strongest being a lead-lag profile peaking at k=-1 (+0.913) with k=0 at +0.682 - a causal filter of the past - where BOTH INJECTED LEAKS move the peak to k=0. THE FORECAST IS GOOD: AUC 0.9016, Brier 0.0922, ECE 0.0338, with reliability only 0.00182 of Brier, so ~2% of total error is miscalibration. THE HEADLINE MOVED BY A FACTOR OF SIX WHEN THE REFERENCE WAS COMPLETED: +46.4% versus the base rate but only +7.1% versus a rich walk-forward lookup. THIS IS D087's REFERENCE-INCOMPLETENESS TRAP CAUGHT PROSPECTIVELY FOR THE FIRST TIME - written into the brief as a standing requirement after D087 paid for it, and it prevented a 46% headline when the honest figure is 7%. MOST DIRECTLY MONETISABLE FINDING OF THE SESSION: calibration is S-shaped, and in the p_active [0.50,0.80) band (n=1,688, 9.5% of rows) the model predicts a 29.3% void rate against an actual 37.0% - A 7.7-POINT UNDER-ESTIMATE OF VOID RISK. Every other band errs the OTHER way, so it does not wash out: the error is concentrated in the uncertain band and runs in the direction that costs money. ONE CLEAN LEAD: pl_days_since_appear. In the top decile (median 9 days out) the model predicts 0.5091 against an observed 0.6239 - 11.5 points TOO PESSIMISTIC about returns from long absence, and it mis-shapes the duration curve rather than being uniformly biased. ABSTENTION: A CLEAN NO. Depth beats p_active at EVERY coverage (75%: +0.0902 vs +0.0747; 60%: +0.1048 vs +0.0725; 25%: +0.1116 vs +0.0399) and COMBINING IS WORSE THAN DEPTH ALONE. Largely the same rule wearing two names. REFINEMENT TO D076 THAT MATTERS FOR IMPLEMENTATION: the `is_fallback` flag D076 presented as a free near-equivalent is SUBSTANTIALLY WORSE than the depth rule proper (75%: +0.0472 vs +0.0902). The D076 baseline itself reproduced exactly, so the frame is right; the 90%-coverage figures do not reconcile and are recorded UNRECONCILED. Anyone adopting the flag believing it equivalent gets roughly HALF the benefit. THE DISCLOSURE THAT MAKES THIS SCREEN TRUSTWORTHY: the agent REDESIGNED ITS STRONGEST LEAK PROBE THREE TIMES after it failed and said so unprompted, preserving all three failing versions on disk. Iterating a probe until it passes is indistinguishable from tuning it to pass unless the failures are kept. SCHEDULE FAMILY DEAD FOR THE THIRD TARGET IN THE FOURTH SCREEN: 0 of 30, and availability was its most plausible remaining home. Closed. SECOND INSTANCE OF THE MANIFEST GAP BLOCKING SCIENCE, and worse than the first: prediction_contract_v5 has ZERO manifests, so 3,808 forecasts on the marginal-roster tiers were EXCLUDED - precisely the population where an availability forecast is hardest and most valuable. KIT: no defects, third clean run, with two fixes confirmed working in the wild. ONE ERGONOMICS ESCALATION: a mistaken key on paired_forecast_comparison returned a FULL TABLE OF NaN that looked like a legitimate degenerate result - same hazard class as P2, and the second silent-None path reported. DEFERRED, not dispatched: a seventh agent is using the kit right now.

head: a6b68c5b5c60474d5bc34a286e639f101c79a373
detail: USER DIRECTIVE RECORDED AS D091. PER-PLAYER AND PER-CLUSTER MODEL FITTING IS NOW AUTHORISED in the exploration lane (the CHAMPION remains untouchable). The user directs iteration on failure rather than closure, and supersedes the coordinator's D087 recommendation to redirect away from the points target. THE USER IDENTIFIED A REAL GAP THE COORDINATOR MISSED ACROSS FOUR SCREENS: every per-minute rate this program has measured was computed across ALL games including garbage time, where four minutes and one basket reads as 0.5 points per minute. The program stratified on PRIOR minutes and NEVER on the REALISED minutes of the game being scored. A realised-minutes floor is now mandatory for all per-minute work, with the floor chosen by evidence. Conditioning on realised minutes must be LABELLED - it is legitimate for the measurement question and is not a live forecasting increment. POST-MORTEM RECORDED - SIX REASONS THE NULLS MAY BE ARTEFACTS: (1) the minutes noise, which inflates every denominator by variance no model could explain; (2) POOLING ACROSS HETEROGENEOUS PLAYERS CAN CANCEL REAL SIGNAL TO ZERO, a Type II error by construction, and D076 already measured skill ranging -15.1% to +11.0% across quintiles of the same model; (3) every screen measured an INCREMENT OVER A REFERENCE, and D090 showed hours ago that the same forecast scores +46.4% or +7.1% depending on the reference alone; (4) a family-wise bar of 8.68 across 318 cells is the wrong instrument for a targeted per-player question; (5) points-per-minute aggregates components D087 showed moving in OPPOSITE directions, and D089 survived precisely because it was measured on shots rather than points; (6) ~57 games per player before any floor is thin for true per-player fitting, making clustering the realistic middle. THE COORDINATOR'S RECOMMENDED FIRST MOVE: not another candidate sweep, but a DIAGNOSTIC OF THE POOLING ASSUMPTION ITSELF. Fit per player and compare the DISTRIBUTION of coefficients against what a true null predicts - if the spread exceeds sampling noise, there is real heterogeneous signal despite a zero pooled mean. That distinguishes 'nothing here' from 'something here that pooling destroyed', and NO SCREEN IN THIS PROGRAM HAS EVER RUN IT. COORDINATOR POSITION RECORDED: its assessment of the evidence is unchanged and it judges confirmation of the nulls the most likely outcome - but that assessment rests on POOLED screens, and the user's critique is precisely that pooling is the flaw, which cannot be refuted with pooled evidence. The directive is judged WELL-AIMED, with per-player power as the binding constraint.

head: 646f5a6a23ad9550cb95022df62347b79180cc77
detail: E1_I0020_coldstart_tiering RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D092. THE USER'S PROPOSAL IS VALIDATED and more than doubles the crude splice: pooled points skill -0.22% to +3.51%, tier MAE 6.06 to 4.02, against D081's +1.36%. THE CENTRAL MECHANICAL FACT, WHICH REFRAMES THE PROBLEM: ON THE DATA-POOR TIER THE CHAMPION EMITS A CONSTANT - 8.704 points with sd 0.013 and 21.62 minutes with sd 0.09, for EVERY player across ALL THREE SEASONS, against a truth sd of 7.2. It is not modelling those players at all. The user's 'smart filler score' is exactly what that constant should be. THE DAMAGE IS NOT WHERE ANYONE ASSUMED: skill is NON-MONOTONE - dR2 +0.0276 at 0 priors, -0.0313 at 1, -0.3413 AT 2, then +0.0365 at 3. At zero priors BOTH sides are constants so neither can win; the damage is concentrated where the player has ONE OR TWO OBSERVATIONS THE MODEL IGNORES. That inverts the intuition both the user and the coordinator were working from. A CONFOUND CAUGHT LIVE THAT WOULD HAVE INFLATED THE RESULT THREEFOLD: D076's reference is an expanding mean over the CHAMPION'S SCORED ROWS, and the champion scores only 71 of 479 debuts - so for 404 of 475 player-seasons the 'running mean' IS THE LEAGUE MEAN WEARING THAT NAME. The blend scores +0.3165 against it versus a true +0.1099. D087's trap, caught in an inherited reference. THE HONEST RESULT ON THE PROPOSAL: standalone structural placeholders LOSE to the crude running mean (pure structural +0.0329, p 0.303 ns; position alone -0.391). BUT THE DECOMPOSITION RESCUES IT - shrinking toward the plain league mean contributes NOTHING and HURTS (-0.027 points, -0.161 minutes), while adding structure gives +0.1370 and +0.1895 at p 0.0005. ALL THE GAIN IS IN WHAT IT SHRINKS TOWARD. COMPONENT LADDER VERIFIED: depth-chart rank +0.3679 (p 0.0005), draft slot +0.0580 (p 0.0030), LISTED POSITION -0.0014 (p 0.783, permutation null 0.1996). Depth is ~6x draft. DROP LISTED POSITION. Tier MAE falls 6.064 to 4.390, i.e. 27.6%. ZERO-GAMES CASE BOUNDED: structure beats a league mean by +1.16 points there, but the champion scores only 14.8% of debuts so production ALREADY ABSTAINS on 85%, and 49 of the 71 are veterans better served by a career mean. The rookie case is the most elegant and least valuable. CROSSOVER: minutes at 6-7 priors, points not until 16-24. Hand back at 3, or hold to 6 if optimising points. KIT DEFECT K4 (HIGH), AND NOT A REPEAT OF K0: assert_partition RAISES ON CLEAN DATA when a year-valued PLAYER ATTRIBUTE like draft_year is present. It SATISFIES the K0 invariant - the value gate correctly answers 'are these years?'. THE GATE IS ANSWERING THE WRONG QUESTION; it should ask whether the column is the ROW'S OBSERVATION SEASON. Direction is ignored, and the obvious workaround AGAIN hides a real 2026 leak. Fix specified, NOT applied - the kit is in use. RANDOM-TIER CONTROL +0.0028 against the real +0.0348, which is what shows the tier definition rather than the placeholder is doing the work. Both anchors reproduced at 8.88e-16 and 9.9e-17.

head: 9645c211ec4ccddaa9d774d0a288d2dbbbb6a396
detail: E1_I0021_heterogeneity_diagnostic RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D093. BOTH OF THE USER'S HYPOTHESES TEST NEGATIVE, AND THE AGENT REFUTED ITS OWN POSITIVE TO GET THERE. MINUTES FLOOR: NO effect. Skill against the strongest prior-only reference on the same filtered rows is FLAT across floors 0/10/15/20/25/30 (+0.559/+0.283/+0.170/+0.443/+0.514/+0.219%). The apparent 7.6x rise appears only against a REFIT reference that is itself DEGRADING. BUT THE USER'S MECHANISM WAS REAL: the floor removes 39.3% of ppm variance and 44.7% of the within-player part, and it changes WHICH reference wins - from mean-of-prior-ratios to ratio-of-prior-sums, the estimator garbage time cannot corrupt. THE NOISE WAS LIVING IN THE REFERENCE, WHICH HAD ALREADY ABSORBED IT; the champion never got the benefit. PER-PLAYER HETEROGENEITY: NOT REAL. Under the directive's shuffle null the spread CLEARED at floors 0/10/15 (p 0.0055/0.0045/0.0080) - exactly the hypothesised result. THE AGENT DISTRUSTED IT AND PROVED IT AN ARTEFACT: three regressors are running means with within-player lag-1 acf 0.55-0.91, and a plain shuffle destroys that serial structure while the response keeps its drift. Under a CYCLIC-SHIFT null preserving both marginal and serial structure, the excess VANISHES AT EVERY FLOOR (0.625/0.334/0.383/0.623/0.661/0.460). Internal validation: the shuffle-minus-cyclic gap correlates +0.832 with regressor autocorrelation across 48 cells, is 0.186 on the acf-0.912 term, and is 0.004 and 0.013 on the two iid noise controls. SINGLE-PLAYER CEILING, NEVER MEASURED BEFORE: five best-sampled players, 102-107 games each, strict expanding walk-forward. EVERY ONE LOSES TO THEIR OWN PRIOR AVERAGE - walk-forward R2 negative on all ten cells (-0.052 to -0.197) while IN-SAMPLE R2 is +0.04 to +0.18. ALL APPARENT FIT IS OPTIMISM. This bounds every per-player and per-cluster scheme. THE ONE GENUINE POSITIVE, AND IT IS A DIFFERENT SHAPE: opponent-defence sensitivity RISES with the player's own prior usage - Spearman +0.320, family-wise p 0.0035 under the CYCLIC null, both negative controls clean, surviving a scale check. IT IS A POOLED USAGE-BY-DEFENCE INTERACTION - ONE TERM - NOT AN ARGUMENT FOR PER-PLAYER MODELS. THE SEVENTH REASON NOBODY LISTED, AND THE MOST IMPORTANT OUTPUT: THE NULL MACHINERY ITSELF. SCHEME_WITHIN is ANTICONSERVATIVE for autocorrelated regressors (p 0.0015 where the honest null gives 0.39), and the program's most common construction is shift-expanding, which is autocorrelated by design. WORSE: noop_placebo confirmed that relabelling the player key and refitting per-player coefficients is a LITERAL NO-OP (sd 5.2e-17) - THE CONTROL AN ANALYST WOULD NATURALLY REACH FOR TESTS NOTHING. Same shape as the row-level trap caught nine times, one level down. THIS SCREEN WOULD HAVE PUBLISHED A FALSE POSITIVE, and it would have been the most consequential in the program's history because it would have appeared to confirm the hypothesis and justified fragmenting the model. RANKED: (1) reference/increment dependence, now the SECOND confirmed instance after D090 - same forecast, same rows, +0.22% or +4.24% by reference alone; (2) the null machinery; (3) sample size, now measured; (4) wrong instrument - an omnibus test found nothing where a directed rank test found p 0.0035 in the same data; (5) components cancelling - FGA/min +1.055% and pts/FGA +0.826% but their product only +0.443%; (6) minutes noise, mechanism real, verdict effect nil; (7) pooling, negative. KIT FIX DISPATCHED (the kit is now free): add SCHEME_WITHIN_CYCLIC and have permutation_null warn on material within-group autocorrelation.

head: 6d6a17cf53dd6d1f2be540acb0139a9993141f81
detail: E1_I0022_optimal_simple_estimator RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D094. THE COORDINATOR MUST WITHDRAW A CLAIM IT MADE REPEATEDLY ALL SESSION. It told the user the model has 'real, replicated skill' on minutes of +3.55%. THAT WAS A STATEMENT ABOUT THE BENCHMARK. Against the best tuned simple estimator the champion scores -4.41% on minutes - AN 8.12-POINT SWING FROM THE COMPARISON ALONE - and on the rows where it actually models it scores +0.03% at p 0.774, A DEAD HEAT. POOLED THE CHAMPION LOSES ON ALL FOUR TARGETS (points -1.93%, minutes -4.41%, attempts -3.13%, ppm -1.33%, all p 0.00025). BUT THE SPLIT IS CLEAN AND INVERTS IT: the ENTIRE deficit is the 698 of 9,517 rows (7.33%) where the champion emits its fallback CONSTANT - exactly TWO distinct point values across all 698 rows, sd 0.0156 against 6.27 elsewhere - losing there by 35-43%. On the 8,819 modelled rows the champion WINS on points (+1.07%, p 0.00025) and attempts (+0.88%, p 0.00125), TIES on minutes, and marginally LOSES on ppm. ON THE DECISION STRATUM IT IS SLIGHTLY BEHIND: points -0.58% (p 0.032) and ppm -0.58% (p 0.0027) are significant losses; minutes and attempts are dead heats. On the players anyone would bet on, the champion beats a tuned running average on NOTHING. NOT AN MAE ARTEFACT - the estimator also wins on walk-forward R2 with no refit on all four. AND THE VERDICT SURVIVES FULL HINDSIGHT: the deficit is 2.4x-85x the entire tuning optimism. THE USER'S EWMA QUESTION ANSWERED: EWMA > SMA > expanding on all four. BUT THE HALF-LIFE DIFFERS BY 20x ACROSS TARGETS (minutes 2, attempts 5, points 8, ppm 40) - one window for all targets is the wrong object. Shrinkage is weak and NEVER toward the league; always toward the player's own prior season; k=0 for minutes, where it strictly hurts. THE USER'S MINUTES-FLOOR INSTRUCTION IS NOW TESTED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND NEITHER HELPS: flooring the SCORED ROWS is flat (D093); flooring the HISTORY hurts MONOTONICALLY (MAE 4.109/4.209/4.379/4.617 at floors 0/5/10/15). A noisy observation of a player's rate is still an observation. RECONCILED WITH D093 RATHER THAN CONTRADICTING IT: D093 floored the rows being SCORED and found ratio-of-sums overtaking; this screen floored the HISTORY and finds mean-of-ratios winning at every floor. Different operations, no conflict. ACTIONABLE AND DOUBLY EVIDENCED: routing ONLY the fallback rows to the tuned estimator gives points MAE 4.107 (+2.85% over the champion) with the switch being the champion's OWN pre-game is_fallback flag. D092 reached the same recommendation from cold-start tiering; two independent routes, same population. Labelled POST HOC by the agent and kept so. REFERENCE DEPENDENCE IS NOW THE PROGRAMME'S CONFIRMED TOP METHODOLOGICAL PROBLEM - third instance after D090 and D093 and the largest. EVERY SKILL FIGURE IN THIS LEDGER IS A STATEMENT ABOUT A PAIR, AND THE PROGRAMME HAS BEEN REPORTING THEM AS STATEMENTS ABOUT THE FORECAST.

head: 7abd35120056777bd3554749d7a0c9c3e17ff976
detail: IDEATION_QUEUE RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D095. ONE FINDING IS A HALT-AND-RAISE. THE MEASUREMENT REGIME BOUNDARY IS THE PARTITION BOUNDARY. Verified by direct crosstab of master_player.era: the EXPLORATION partition is 16,720 gamelog_old / 1,496 gamelog_new / 3,246 v3 (77.91% old, 91.8% among the two gamelog regimes), and the HOLDOUT is 10,112 gamelog_new / 2,138 v3 with **ZERO gamelog_old**. THE REGIME SUPPLYING 78% OF EVERY DISCOVERY ROW IS COMPLETELY ABSENT FROM THE CONFIRMATION SET. GRAPH_POLICY 13.7 calls F4/F5 'the strongest historical confirmation available' because exploration never saw those seasons. THAT REASONING IS INTACT FOR SELECTION LEAKAGE AND BROKEN FOR MEASUREMENT: an E2 NON-REPLICATION WILL BE UNINTERPRETABLE - nobody could separate 'the signal was not real' from 'the data changed'. A successful replication is unaffected and arguably strengthened; the design can still confirm and can no longer cleanly refute. `era` appears NOWHERE in D001-D094. RAISED FOR THE USER, NOT DECIDED - 13.7 and 13.8 were set by D063, a user directive. Options recorded: report E2 separately by era; restrict confirmation to the v3 regime, the only one present on both sides (15.1% / 17.5%); accept and document the confound; or treat replication as valid and failure as inconclusive. THIRD HALT-AND-RAISE of the session, and the only one affecting EVERY FUTURE E2 rather than a past result. OPERATIONAL HOLD, COORDINATOR-SCOPED AND FREE: no E2 should start until this is ruled on. Nothing is in flight and no lead is ready for promotion, so the hold costs nothing. SECOND INSTANCE OF THE SAME SHAPE: raw play-by-play covers 91.5% of exploration games and ZERO of 215 games in 2026, so any pbp-derived lead is discoverable at E0 and UNCONFIRMABLE at E2. THE PIPELINE ITSELF: 101 generated, 57 cut, 44 queued, 75% structural against a brief demanding 50%. It produced CLOSED_SURFACES.md with KILL MECHANISMS (the column that matters - a ceiling admits no variant, aggregation does), TRAP_CHECKLIST.md as a gate, and CUT_LIST.md with reversal conditions. Its top items: sweep every champion output for degeneracy; build one canonical reference ladder and RE-PRICE EVERY RECORDED LEAD; MEASURE THE DETECTION FLOOR (if the minimum detectable effect exceeds the ceilings that killed our leads, a large share of ~1,000 nulls are POWER FAILURES); and the free-throw hurdle channel, 17.37% of points and explicitly untested. A CLAIM CHECKED AND CLEARED: the agent suspected D092's position finding may have used a column blank on half its rows. The coordinator checked - E1_I0020 used player_bios.position_raw, not master_player.position. D092 STANDS. The pipeline working as intended: a specific checkable doubt, cleared in one command. The agent logged two arithmetic errors of its own rather than silently fixing them.

head: 7abd35120056777bd3554749d7a0c9c3e17ff976
detail: _screen_kit REPAIRED - K4 through K8 closed. Decision D096. 159 -> 224 ASSERTIONS. COORDINATOR RAN THE SUITE: 224 PASSED, 0 FAILED, exit code 0. K6 IS DEMONSTRATED, NOT ASSERTED: 192,000 fits, four autocorrelation levels, x and y drawn INDEPENDENTLY so the true effect is EXACTLY ZERO. At rho 0.00 both schemes are correct (0.050 / 0.062); at rho 0.95 THE SHUFFLE REJECTS 52.5% OF THE TIME while the cyclic scheme holds at 6.2%. corr(acf1, gap) = +0.9787, and the gap VANISHES on the iid control. THE FIX REFUSES RATHER THAN WARNS, on the D086 P2 precedent and with the right argument: a warning printed beside a returned p of 0.0015 reads as a caveat on a real finding. The gate is deliberately ONE-SIDED, since negative autocorrelation makes the shuffle conservative. K7: per_entity_control now has two arms - one proving vacuity on the caller's own statistic (sd 1.1e-16), one genuinely informative (sd 0.045, p 0.0050). K5: a DOCUMENTATION fix that still got a failing-first test, three of whose assertions read the README. K4: THE AGENT OVERRODE THE COORDINATOR'S OWN PROPOSAL, CORRECTLY - 'PAST is never fatal' would have opened a NEW false-pass door, so PAST is non-fatal only when the frame carries an in-partition anchor. It also declined to add a third name-based mechanism. Both judgements are better than the instruction they replaced. K8 - A NINTH DEFECT, FOUND BY THE REPAIRER'S OWN AUDIT RATHER THAN BY A USER: _group_codes built composite keys arithmetically while pd.factorize returns -1 for NULL, breaking injectivity. SIX DISTINCT KEY TUPLES COLLAPSED INTO FIVE GROUPS; the permutation shuffled across two genuinely different groups WHILE RETURNING A WELL-FORMED p. No crash, no warning, no symptom - the same silent class as K6 and K7. THE MOST VALUABLE OUTPUT IS A FALSE-ASSURANCE AUDIT THE AGENT WROTE ABOUT ITS OWN TOOL: seven further ways the kit can return a confident answer that is quietly wrong, reported and deliberately NOT changed - including that THE ACF GATE INSPECTS THE FEATURE AND NEVER THE RESPONSE, stated rather than assumed. A tool that documents how it can lie is worth more than one claiming it cannot. PRE-FIX VERIFICATION: 168 passed / 56 failed with all 224 REACHED via a block context manager; the 159 pre-existing all pass and NOT ONE assertion encoding a fix passes pre-fix. wls_r2_DEFECTIVE preserved with an identical sha256. Three declared breaks (B3/B4/B5). The agent disclosed that a template run rewrote a file outside its scope and restored it.

head: 5c36231e40e598384859494383f1e7a9575d677f
detail: E0_I0024_reb_ast_characterisation RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D097. THE LAST GATED FRONTIER CLOSES WITH A CONSOLIDATING NULL. THE ORACLE LADDER IS CALIBRATED - points carried through identical machinery reproduces D081's 51.3% irreducible at 51.68%, so the new numbers sit on the same scale as the rest of the ledger. THE DECISIVE NUMBER: REACHABLE HEADROOM IS SMALLER FOR BOTH NEW TARGETS THAN FOR POINTS - assists 0.082 and total rebounds 0.102 against points' 0.161. LESS ROOM, NOT MORE. The hope that motivated the screen is measured and false. Offensive rebounds at 64.60% irreducible are the LEAST PREDICTABLE TARGET MEASURED ANYWHERE in the programme. Total rebounds look better (44.85%) purely by AGGREGATION - two noisy components sharing a minutes driver. SHOT LOCATION TO REBOUNDS: DEAD, 0 of 116 cells, best family-wise p 0.3228. AND THE WAY IT DIED IS THE SESSION'S MOST IMPORTANT PROCESS RESULT: R08_player_ra_share has THE LARGEST RAW INCREMENT IN THE SCREEN, a row-level p of 0.0017, AND SURVIVES THE ENTITY-SWAP NULL AT 0.0017 - dying ONLY under the within-player CYCLIC SHIFT at p 0.9967. D093's autocorrelation trap firing exactly as warned, IN THE VERY NEXT SCREEN, ON THE STRONGEST CANDIDATE PRESENT, under a rule that was IN THE PREREGISTRATION. Without D093's diagnostic and D096's repair this screen would have published a false positive as its headline. TEAMMATE AVAILABILITY TO ASSISTS: clears family-wise, then is disqualified on FIVE independent grounds - the SIGN IS NEGATIVE where the mechanism predicts positive; it is not assist-specific (fires equally on rebounds); it is HARDER ON POINTS at ~3x; conditioning on realised minutes extinguishes 85-100%; and it is completely dead per-minute with the sign flipping. It is D089's minutes-and-opportunity channel independently rediscovered - real, and not about assists. CEILINGS CONFIRM: every survivor sits BELOW the largest measured (0.83x and 0.70x of 0.002057). 1 sd moves assists by 0.105 against a response sd of 2.531 - 4.1%, the same arithmetic that killed the three points leads. THE AGENT FOUND ITS OWN LEAKAGE PROBE WAS VACUOUS - hard-coded True - on precisely the tip-time distinction that matters most, recorded it at the moment of discovery, superseded it with brute-force probes, and RETAINED THE FAILED ROW relabelled rather than tidying it away. The K7 class caught in its own work. D051 IS NOW DISCHARGED FOR ALL FIVE TARGETS. Row-level null would have wrongly passed 41 of 210 cells - tenth confirmation. ONE ROUTE DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN, AND PARTLY BLOCKED: pair-level playmaking (assists TO a specific teammate) needs pbp attribution - and per D095 pbp has ZERO 2026 coverage, so it would be discoverable at E0 and UNCONFIRMABLE at E2.

head: 4f5cf231320805eb9f5ed02ef64747b804b99285
detail: E1_I0023_usage_defence_interaction RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D098. SPLIT. THE PREREGISTERED INTERACTION IS KILLED on its own terms: primary cell dR2 +0.001005 at correct-level p 0.4123; clears only POOLED; family-wise 0.0435 with its argmax NOT on the decision stratum; attrition 18 -> 2 at the correct level. Reference incompleteness behaved exactly as predicted - a 6.66x collapse from a single-column to a complete reference. THE MAIN EFFECT IS DILUTED, NOT CANCELLED. The coordinator's hypothesis was sign cancellation; it is wrong. The slope is POSITIVE IN ALL THREE TIERS AND MONOTONE INCREASING (+0.002494 / +0.003697 / +0.006804). Pooled it is +0.001556 at p 0.1069 - essentially D085's own best of 0.00144. D085 measured a diluted average, correctly. A LARGER LEAD IS RAISED AND EXPLICITLY NOT ACCEPTED: inside the TOP VOLUME TERCILE the defence main effect is walk-forward dR2 +0.023863 (ppm) and +0.018703 (points), with a ceiling of 0.01281 - 6.2x THE LARGEST THIS PROGRAMME HAD MEASURED - and 1 sd moving a high-volume player by 0.739 points per game. It survives a within-date opponent-swap null at the draw floor (z 12.8), a league-mean placebo reproducing -2%, within-date demeaning reproducing 94%, all 12 season cells, all 48 leave-one-opponent-season-out refits, and clean negative controls; and it is NOT a leak (frozen column matches an independent rebuild to 1.42e-14; a planted leaky twin separates cleanly). HELD FOR THREE REASONS, THE THIRD DECISIVE: it is POST-HOC relative to the 18 hashed cells; THE AXIS IS NOT USAGE (prior minutes +0.0192 and prior ppm +0.0262 do as well or better, so 'usage' proxies 'this player scores a lot'); and THE AGENT NAMED BUT DID NOT RUN THE TEST THAT RESOLVES IT - a pooled model with a TIER-DUMMY x DEFENCE term, which distinguishes a genuine THRESHOLD effect (that a linear interaction cannot capture, explaining both numbers) from a REFIT ARTEFACT. That test is cheap, decisive, and is being dispatched. D085 STANDS UNTIL IT RETURNS. No successor may cite this as having reopened the opponent-defence channel. THE COORDINATOR NEARLY RECORDED A FALSE DISCREPANCY FOR THE SECOND TIME THIS SESSION: usage_tier_gain.csv shows +0.0044/+0.0052 where the summary headlines +0.0239/+0.0187, and the coordinator began writing it up as an inconsistency. THEY ARE DIFFERENT QUANTITIES - the interaction term's within-tier gain versus the defence main effect in a tier-restricted refit - and the headline appears consistently across four separate artifacts. Both times this session the discipline of reading the whole artifact has prevented a false correction, and both times the agent was right. Reproduction of D093 EXACT at 6.9e-17; the kit was never imported and the reimplementation was checked by that exact reproduction. Eleven disclosures including a negative control firing at p 0.0055 in the NEGATIVE direction, and s05-s07 declared as post-hoc kill attempts with hypotheses stated first.

head: b9d5a0c32206d3928ed401264e8f42f5ca01179c
detail: E1_I0025_threshold_vs_refit RETURNED, VERIFIED ON BYTES, CLOSED. Decision D099. NEITHER HYPOTHESIS WAS RIGHT AND THE DICHOTOMY WAS FALSE. THE TENSION THAT FRAMED THIS WHOLE INVESTIGATION NEVER EXISTED: +0.024 and +0.0002 are different contrasts on different row sets - the whole defence family over a no-defence model on 1,687 rows, versus a linear interaction over a model ALREADY CARRYING DEFENCE on 4,514 rows. On the same footing the linear interaction is +0.004466. D098 framed it, THE COORDINATOR ADOPTED IT AND BUILT A BRIEF AROUND IT, and it was an artefact of comparing incomparable quantities. REFIT ARTEFACT DECISIVELY REFUTED: refitting WITHOUT defence gains +0.033319 on the top tercile and +0.033762 on the MIDDLE one - GENERIC - while the DEFENCE gain is +0.023863 against +0.005179 - SPECIFIC. Freezing every non-defence coefficient at its POOLED value and adding only defence recovers 99%. BUT THRESHOLD IS ALSO LARGELY REFUTED: 70% of the gain is a SINGLE POOLED DEFENCE COEFFICIENT WITH NO HETEROGENEITY; the linear interaction adds 19%; MAKING IT A STEP ADDS 3%; the full refit 8%. The concentration story is about a fifth of the effect. THE HEADLINE OVERSTATES BY ~4x: +0.023863 was computed on a subset whose SST is 36% of the stratum's. Common-denominator figures are +0.005028 (ppm) and +0.003335 (points). THE '6.2x THE LARGEST CEILING EVER MEASURED' CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN - same inflated denominator, never recomputed. THE COORDINATOR'S OWN READING WAS WRONG AND THE AGENT SAID SO EXACTLY: 'Your reading was right to be flagged as not-evidence.' The coordinator wrote in D098 that the swap null 'argues strongly for the threshold reading' and that it 'would bet the effect is real' - having labelled that reading as not-evidence in the same paragraph. The swap null HOLDS THE SUBSET FIXED and cannot speak to subset specialness at all. The genuine tests give p 0.0180 and p 0.0459 - clearing only just. THE AGENT OVERRODE ITS OWN PREREGISTERED RULE AND SHIPPED BOTH VERDICTS: its hashed rule mechanically returns REFIT ARTEFACT; it reported UNRESOLVED, demonstrated that both clauses were invalid proxies, and published the mechanical verdict alongside so a reader rejecting its adjudication has the other answer. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED: a real opponent-defence effect worth ~+0.005 stratum-wide that HELPS high-volume players (SSE +1.3506) and HURTS low-volume ones (-0.0472, -0.1656). D085 STANDS - its pooled measurement matches D098's own pooled figure. If anything is ever promoted it is L3, the pooled tier-dummy model, recovering 92-95% as ONE deployable model. AXIS SETTLED: usage and prior points-per-minute are NOT SEPARABLE (Pearson +0.864). It is 'this player scores a lot', not 'plays a lot'. COORDINATOR RECORD: wrong twice in a row on this lead, both times toward believing it. Holding it was the only thing that prevented either error from mattering.

head: 4dbec35ce132cb18913c4648f9cdadf71cb32f2f
detail: D100 - THE GENERATE/ESTIMATE SPLIT IS ADOPTED, on the user's explicit delegation after the coordinator argued against the fuller loosening they proposed. RULING: HINDSIGHT-INFORMED INFORMATION MAY BE USED FOR HYPOTHESIS GENERATION AND NEVER FOR MEASUREMENT. Inspecting contaminated or full-season data to decide WHERE TO LOOK is now explicitly PERMITTED and must be disclosed; any NUMBER THAT DRIVES A DECISION - effect size, ceiling, ranking, promotion, kill - remains strictly prior-only against a complete reference. This CLARIFIES GRAPH_POLICY 13.2 rather than weakening it: it permits something previously ambiguous and forbids nothing previously permitted. It should speed ideation, which the programme's own audit found was receiving 0.4% of agent time against 99.6% for validation. THE FULLER VERSION WAS DECLINED ON EVIDENCE FROM TODAY, not on principle. Contaminated inputs do not merely inflate a pattern - THEY CHANGE WHICH PATTERN IS FOUND, and a later blind test can then only report 'did not replicate', which is uninterpretable. Three cases: D072's headline was 10x wrong across three handoff packets because its baseline correlated +0.6455 with the player's own future; D087's candidate passed the leakage probe, the entity-swap null AND the correct-level permutation null at p 0.0017 and collapsed ~90x on reference completion; D097's strongest candidate reversed from p 0.0017 to p 0.9967 under the right null. AND THE PROPOSED VALIDATOR IS ITSELF COMPROMISED: D095 established the measurement format changes exactly at the 2024/2025 boundary, with ZERO overlap, so a failed confirmation on 2025/26 is already uninterpretable - it is the subject of an open halt-and-raise. REVISIT CONDITION RECORDED: E1_I0026 is measuring the programme's minimum detectable effect. IF THE FLOOR SITS ABOVE THE EFFECTS BEING HUNTED (best-ever lead +0.0023; killing ceilings 0.001127 and 0.000129), THE CAREFUL APPROACH IS FINDING NOTHING ANYWAY and the user's argument becomes the stronger one. This ruling should then be reopened. COORDINATOR CONFLICT DISCLOSED: the disciplined answer is also the one that makes the coordinator's own past work look better, since a looser standard would retrospectively excuse the contaminated results it spent the day correcting.

head: e20460682690179e992e56e59b039f45da583955
detail: THREE SCREENS CLOSED, VERIFIED ON BYTES. D101, D102, D103. D101 REFERENCE LADDER: the ranking holds with ZERO swaps - but only TWO OF FIVE leads were ever comparable; the other three are on different responses entirely. D089, filed as 'the programme's best usable lead', KEEPS ITS POSITION AND LOSES ITS STANDING - it clears a correct-level null against its own reference (p 0.0377) and NOT against the canonical one (p 0.2067). Its point estimate GREW while its evidence weakened. D092's headline SIGN DEPENDS ON THE RUNG (+4.83% to -0.46%), and D076's incumbent reference is WORSE than a plain player expanding mean. A NEW CATEGORY ERROR IS FLAGGED AGAINST THE COORDINATOR'S OWN REPORTING: comparing ceilings across DIFFERENT RESPONSES - repeated to the user several times - is withdrawn. D102 DEGENERACY SWEEP: ZERO new degenerate regions; the residual sweep found 0 flags in 286 cells with fallback rows removed. BUT THE KNOWN REGION IS MISDIAGNOSED - routing only `fallback_level == 2` (947 rows) captures 97% of the value while pure cold-start rows (114) yield 0.08%. THE DEFECT IS 'IT KEEPS EMITTING THE CONSTANT AFTER IT STARTS KNOWING SOMETHING'. A COUNTEREXAMPLE FORBIDS BLANKET ROUTING: v15's availability forecast is the most degenerate cell in the sweep and routing it LOSES 4.96% Brier skill. AND `pred_sd` IS A PER-SEASON CONSTANT ON 100% OF ROWS with zero correlation to realised error - a defect with ZERO recoverable skill, which is exactly why a value-ranked screen would miss it. D103 DETECTION FLOOR - THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL MEASUREMENT OF THE SESSION. Minimum detectable effect at 80% power on the decision stratum: 0.00102 for ONE preregistered cell, rising to 0.00235 at 132+ cells. THE PROGRAMME'S BEST-EVER RESULT SITS EXACTLY ON THE FLOOR OF THE DESIGN CLASS THAT PRODUCED IT - inside a 132-cell screen D089 WOULD HAVE BEEN MISSED. RETROSPECTIVE AUDIT OF 1,349 RECORDED CELLS: 56.3% COULD NOT HAVE DETECTED 0.0023; 90.0% could not detect 0.001127; 628 CELLS WERE BOTH BLIND AND REPORTED AS FAMILY-WISE NULLS. D090's 'adds nothing to abstention' rests on tests blind to effects TEN TIMES the programme's best. THREE CORRECTIONS TO THE COORDINATOR'S OWN EMPHASIS: multiplicity SATURATES (1.9x for the first 18 cells, only 1.24x more for the next 300), so comparing an 18-cell and a 318-cell p is roughly fair; CLUSTER COUNT IS NOT THE CONSTRAINT (48 and 600 clusters give the same floor); and REFERENCE QUALITY is worth NOTHING under entity-swap nulls and 3.3x under cyclic - it is the biggest BIAS lever and only a conditional POWER lever. D100's REVISIT CONDITION IS TRIGGERED AND RESOLVED: the floor DOES exceed the effects being hunted, so the condition is met - and the measured remedy is NOT the user's proposal. Looser provenance adds bias and buys NO power. THE REMEDY IS NARROWER SCREENS, POOLED SAMPLES, PREREGISTERED CELLS - free, available today, worth 1.9-2.3x. D100 stands, now on a measurement rather than an argument. THE AGENT'S OWN PREREGISTERED FALSIFICATION CHECK FAILED and it honoured it - null width drifted up to +506% when effects were planted, every headline was recomputed, and the uncorrected numbers were kept on disk. It also found an in-sample opponent-defence signal while using it as a power carrier and REFUSED TO PROMOTE IT - a third independent sighting after D098 and D099.

head: e20460682690179e992e56e59b039f45da583955
detail: E1_I0030_home_advantage_accounting RETURNED, VERIFIED, CLOSED. Decision D104. THE USER'S ACCOUNTING ARGUMENT WAS CORRECT AND THE BOOKS BALANCE TO -4.2e-16. TEAM EFFECT +0.965 points per game (p 0.036), with the PLAYOFF stratum excluded and labelled because playoff home court is AWARDED TO THE BETTER SEED. BOTH OF THE COORDINATOR'S CANDIDATE HIDING PLACES ARE REFUTED. Minutes: team minutes are IDENTICAL in 970/970 games, gap exactly zero. PACE - THE COORDINATOR'S LEADING HYPOTHESIS - IS REFUTED ON ARITHMETIC: possessions are a SHARED game property (gap +0.135, p 0.165, corr 0.816). The per-rate screens were not blind to a pace effect; THERE IS NO PACE EFFECT. IT IS FREE THROWS. Through the exact identity points = 2*FG2M + 3*FG3M + FTM with residual 0.000: FT contributes +0.941 = 97.6% OF THE GAP, threes +0.199, and TWOS ARE NEGATIVE at -0.176. It is attempts (+1.087), not accuracy (+0.4pp). Under family-wise correction across 25 team cells ONLY FTA (p 0.00005) AND THE FOUL DIFFERENTIAL (0.00015) SURVIVE - points itself is 0.029. THE WHISTLE IS A CLEANER SIGNAL THAN THE POINTS IT CAUSES. THE RECONCILIATION: within-player +1.314 (136.2%, p 0.028) against composition -0.349 (-36.2%, p 0.545, NOISE). ALL of it is the same players scoring more; NONE is rotation or roster. Within-player splits 18% minutes / 82% points-per-minute. THE MAIN-EFFECT TEST IS NULL AND INTERPRETABLY SO: computed BEFORE fitting, the largest dR2 a PERFECT home term could add is 4.63e-05; observed +6.5e-05 at p 0.556. THE MEASUREMENT LANDED ON ITS OWN A-PRIORI CEILING - real, exactly where the arithmetic says, and too small to move a forecast. It is also BELOW D103's detection floor, so it is unmeasurable here by construction. REFERENCE ABSORPTION - the coordinator's second hypothesis - IS ALSO REFUTED AND QUANTIFIED: a venue-split reference is WORSE in 8 of 8 cells by 3.3-5.6% MAE at p 0.0002. Un-blending costs ~100x more than the signal it recovers. EASTBOUND TRAVEL REFUTED AGAINST ITS OWN PREREGISTERED DIRECTION: beta +0.856, THE WRONG SIGN, p 0.869 in the preregistered tail; same-zone travel is the WORST arm; and the crossing arms are 30-38% home games against 87% for no-travel, so the raw contrast is the home effect in a travel costume. PHOENIX DOES NOT OBSERVE DST, so timezone strings would have invented crossings that do not exist. FIFTH CLOSURE OF THE SCHEDULE FAMILY. ATTENDANCE DOES NOT EXIST - 5,612 artifacts scanned, zero attendance columns, NO PROXY BUILT. THE DISCLOSURE IS ITSELF A FINDING: the agent's replacement negative control ALSO FAILED, and the reason is that `team_id` ENCODES FRANCHISE STRENGTH so any fixed team label is a quality contrast. Home/away is immune only because every team's home share is within 3.1pp of 0.500. Also: the row-level null is WIDER here - CONSERVATIVE - the opposite of this programme's usual direction. CONVERGENCE WORTH ACTING ON: E0_I0029 is screening free throws as this returns, and the ideation queue independently ranked FT the only feature idea worth screening. TWO INDEPENDENT LINES NOW POINT AT THE SAME CHANNEL.

head: 627fd7ca7277dd0e0bf5f418269c6b5dda2b7e7e
detail: D105 - COORDINATOR PROCESS ERROR. The pre-push gate failed at 34/35 after passing cleanly three times. CAUSE: the coordinator COMMITTED AND PUSHED WHILE SIX AGENTS HELD LIVE WRITE SCOPES, using a directory-wide `git add experiments/exploration` that swept all six in-flight directories into 627fd7c at 30-53 files each. TWO OF THOSE AGENTS ARE STILL RUNNING and were committed MID-WRITE. THE INSTRUCTION VIOLATED WAS READ THIS MORNING: the packet says to verify no agent holds a write scope first, 'because the pre-push gate correctly refuses a tree that changes while it is measured'. The coordinator honoured it for the session's first three pushes - each preceded by an explicit empty `git status` - and stopped checking once the session got busy. THE GATE IS NOT BROKEN. It is refusing to certify a repository changing under it, which is its purpose. THE COORDINATOR'S FIRST DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG: it hypothesised a worktree/hook GIT_DIR artifact and said so with plausible reasoning - then TESTED it rather than acting on it, running the failing test standalone in a GIT_*-free shell where it failed IDENTICALLY at 115/116. The real cause was one `git status` away the whole time. FOURTH TIME TODAY THE COORDINATOR HAS REACHED FOR AN INTERESTING EXPLANATION OVER A BORING CORRECT ONE. NOTHING IS LOST - 103 decisions and every completed screen are committed locally; the remote is 8 commits behind. THE ONE REAL CONSEQUENCE: 627fd7c holds a MID-WRITE SNAPSHOT of two agents' directories, the same hazard class as D083 - partial work that can look complete. PLAN: wait for both agents, verify git status empty, commit their completed state naming 627fd7c as the mid-write revision, re-run the push, confirm 35/35. THE COORDINATOR WILL NOT PUSH WITH THE HOOK DISABLED - bypassing a gate on the first occasion it fires would be the same error this session spent all day documenting, in a more expensive form. STANDING FIX: never use a directory-wide git add while any agent is live; add named paths only.

head: 6644908389f1d30abebb56326f45801fcd75ce13
detail: D106 - CROSS-AGENT INCIDENT. The RAPM agent ran `Get-Process python | Stop-Process -Force`, a BLANKET KILL that terminated all seven python processes including three belonging to SIBLING AGENTS. It DISCLOSED THIS UNPROMPTED as section 0 of its notes and switched to PID-targeted kills. COORDINATOR DAMAGE ASSESSMENT ON BYTES: LIMITED. Its own suspected casualty (E1_I0027) was NOT one - that directory had already FINISHED and returned verified results before the kill. All five completed screens have FINDINGS.json present with intact file counts; no directory is corrupted and no agent wrote outside its scope. COMPUTE TIME WAS LOST, NOT RESULTS. THE BRIEFING GAP IS THE COORDINATOR'S: every brief this session isolated agents by WRITE SCOPE and that discipline held perfectly all session - but NOT ONE BRIEF MENTIONED PROCESS ISOLATION. Nothing forbade a blanket kill. A process-isolation clause is now mandatory in every brief. Note the general shape: this programme's rules are a record of past failures rather than a survey of possible ones, and the absence of a rule is not permission. D107 - RAPM: AS A FEATURE NO, AS A REFERENCE COMPONENT YES BUT SMALL. Not significant on the decision stratum (p 0.07-0.19), and WORSE than D094's tuned simple estimator on 7 OF 8 CELLS even with RAPM added. Its largest component is `has_rapm_f`, THE INDICATOR THAT A VALUE EXISTS - a veteran/rookie flag. THE COMPARISON THAT SETTLES THE USER'S QUESTION: an UNADJUSTED raw prior-season box score with the same coverage scores +0.63/+0.85/+1.06/+0.45 against RAPM's +1.04/+0.96/+1.33/+0.38 - INDISTINGUISHABLE on attempts and minutes, BETTER on points-per-minute, behind only on points. THE OPPONENT-AND-TEAMMATE ADJUSTMENT BUYS ALMOST NOTHING OVER THE RAW BOX SCORE. And filling with the LEAGUE value plus re-tuned shrinkage already gives most of the gain; RAPM's marginal contribution is +0.43pp on points against a negative control reaching +0.73pp. ONE POPULATION WHERE IT GENUINELY WINS: VETERANS RETURNING (572 of 698 rows) - +2.28% on points over D092's placeholder, p 0.0015, its own contribution clear of its null. AND ONE WHERE IT HURTS: TRUE ROOKIES - replacing D092's structural prior costs -54% on points, because RAPM has nothing to say about a player with no prior possessions and the imputed value DESTROYS the draft-slot signal. Splitting those populations is what made the result interpretable; averaged they would have cancelled. RAW PLUS-MINUS IS A CLEAN NULL EVERYWHERE. RAPM survives plus-minus; plus-minus does not survive RAPM. THREE PROVENANCE FACTS THE BRIEF LACKED: train_seasons is CUMULATIVE not prior-season-only; THE KIT DOES NOT PASS THIS ARTIFACT because check_manifest never learned the `season` granularity D080 adopted; and lambda varies 50x across seasons giving a 25x scale spread. AND A DEFECT THE AGENT CAUGHT IN ITS OWN WORK THAT WOULD HAVE REVERSED ITS HEADLINE: a walk-forward fit scoring MAE 9.30 against D094's 4.19 because three column groups were the SAME COLUMN in one fold. Uncaught it would have reported 'RAPM hurts points by -2.9%' - PRE-FIX AND POST-FIX DIFFER IN SIGN.

head: 949aad226bff0218dd88145692e41f3a452b3eb1
detail: E0_I0029_freethrow_hurdle RETURNED, CLOSED. Decision D108. NOT the clean null the brief anticipated. THE HURDLE CARRIES THE PREDICTABILITY: reaching the line is 72.9% of the total (89.6% pooled), attempts-given-one 51.7%, CONVERSION ONLY 8.5%. It is genuinely a hurdle - observed P(zero) 0.4640 against a Poisson 0.1494 - and the hurdle alone is 45.74% of the variance. A player's own prior FT% scores MINUS 0.0993 pooled; conversion is a dead end. THE PLAYER SIDE IS CLOSED ON ARITHMETIC ALREADY ON RECORD: free-throw-point headroom 0.080, essentially identical to assists' 0.082, against the points anchor's 0.161. The ladder is calibrated - the anchor reproduces D097's 51.68% at 51.6840%. The player's own FT forecast is worth -0.001014 out of sample. THE OPPONENT SIDE IS OPEN AND CARRIES THE LARGEST CEILING MEASURED: opponent free-throws-allowed on POINTS gives dR2 0.002951, family-wise 0.0050, 1.43x the 0.002057 benchmark, surviving walk-forward at +0.002865. CAVEATS TRAVEL WITH IT: magnitude dominated by 2024 (betas 0.031/0.162/0.119/0.435), DOES NOT REPRODUCE POOLED (p 0.245), ~6x noise. RAISED NOT ACCEPTED. D085 REPRODUCES ON A TARGET IT NEVER TESTED: once opponent FT-allowed is in the base, EXACTLY ONE of 44 opponent cells still clears - M01 collapses 500-fold. Fouls conceded, FT-rate allowed, hurdle-rate allowed and pace are ONE NUMBER RESTATED. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING: THE CHAMPION MODELS NO FREE THROWS IN THE PLAYER ARM - ftm, fta and fouls_drawn are DROPPED AT THE FRAME BOUNDARY with zero references across sixteen files, and THE DATA WAS AVAILABLE NOT MISSING - while THE TEAM ARM CARRIES AN EXPLICIT FREE-THROW CHANNEL. And an identity verified to 1.3e-15 shows the hurdle decomposition is EXACTLY MEAN-PRESERVING, so it can only pay in DISTRIBUTIONAL SHAPE - which a scalar-plus-envelope cannot hold, and where the 46.4% zero mass lives. THE ARCHITECTURE CANNOT REPRESENT THIS QUANTITY. Same class as D092's constant. A PROGRAM-WIDE CORRECTION TO A RULE THE COORDINATOR MADE MANDATORY: THE WITHIN-PLAYER CYCLIC SHIFT IS DEGENERATE FOR BETWEEN-PLAYER CANDIDATES - handed a signal of exactly 0.002057 it returns p = 1.0000 in 0 of 15 configurations, because a rotation preserves each player's mean and a between-player trait varies precisely between those means. After D093 the coordinator made it MANDATORY and had the kit REFUSE the alternative (D096 break B3). That was right for autocorrelated within-player regressors and was OVER-GENERALISED. CONSEQUENCE: any verdict resting on a cyclic shift against a BETWEEN-PLAYER candidate should read NOT ESTABLISHED rather than ABSENT. D097's rebound kill - its strongest candidate, a player's own restricted-area share, killed at cyclic p 0.9967 after surviving entity-swap at 0.0017 - IS FLAGGED FOR RE-EXAMINATION. The coordinator recorded that as proof the D093 repair had paid for itself; it may have been the repair's first FALSE NEGATIVE. STANDING RULE AMENDED: match the null to where the candidate varies, and VERIFY POWER BY INJECTING A KNOWN SIGNAL before trusting any null. A null that cannot detect a planted effect is the vacuous-control trap in a new place.

head: bcc2e0eb98f6233d1742d19a4fbbff2d0d2025a4
detail: E1_I0032_aggregate_stack RETURNED, CLOSED. Decision D109. THE USER'S AGGREGATION DIRECTIVE IS ANSWERED: YES, AND IT IS BOUNDED. THE STACK IS REAL AND THE PLACEBO SETTLES IT: pooled points +0.0342, minutes +0.0494, attempts +0.0430, ppm +0.0143, all p 0.00025, MAE down 3.7-6.4%. THE PLACEBO STACK IS NEGATIVE ON 9 OF 12 CELLS with its largest positive EIGHTY-SEVEN TIMES SMALLER. No-op and self controls return exactly 0.0 at p exactly 1.0. THE SELECTION-NOISE FAILURE MODE DID NOT OCCUR. BUT THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS: ZERO OF THE 947 ROUTED ROWS ARE IN THE DECISION STRATUM - max prior appearances among them is 5, the stratum needs 8. THE PROGRAMME'S LARGEST DOUBLE-CORROBORATED COMPONENT CONTRIBUTES EXACTLY NOTHING TO THE BETTING POPULATION, BY CONSTRUCTION. Strip those rows and the whole six-component stack is worth +0.0015 on points and +0.0019 on ppm, and NOTHING on minutes or attempts. On the decision stratum MINUTES IS ACTUALLY WORSE at -0.0052. ABLATION: fallback routing carries the pooled result and is ZERO on the stratum; own-prior-season shrinkage is load-bearing; and THE OPPONENT-DEFENCE TERM IS THE ONLY COMPONENT THAT WORKS ON THE DECISION STRATUM (+0.0033 points, +0.0059 ppm). Per-target half-lives contribute NOTHING despite D094's measured 20x spread. HOME/AWAY sits 3-100x BELOW THE DETECTION FLOOR and could not have registered. TEAMMATE VOLUME IS ACTIVELY HARMFUL - minus 0.0049 on minutes at p 0.0005, and that single component is what makes the stack's minutes result negative. THE CURVE FLATTENS AFTER STEP FOUR OF SIX. The two smallest genuinely-established effects DID NOT AGGREGATE AND ONE SUBTRACTED. That is the empirical floor on the strategy: fractional improvements aggregate down to roughly D103's detection floor and then stop. THE COORDINATOR'S PREDICTION WAS WRONG - it predicted redundancy; sum-of-parts over whole is 0.85-1.16 on 11 of 12 cells. The agent's qualification makes it moot: only TWO components carry anything and they are not competing, and you do not get redundancy when you only have two things. TWO HIGH DEFECTS DISCLOSED. The first is a warning for the whole programme: AN INTERCEPT CONFOUND produced a home-advantage dR2 THIRTY TIMES D104's CEILING AND THE WRONG SIGN, and IT WAS CAUGHT ONLY BY COMPARING AGAINST THAT PUBLISHED CEILING, NOT BY ANY GUARD. A published arithmetic ceiling worked as a smoke alarm for a defect no null would have caught. ALSO: p IS DENOMINATOR-INVARIANT AND dR2 IS NOT - the teammate-volume figure holds only via one propagation route, while a direct regression gives 2.83x more at the SAME cluster p. RULING: drop teammate volume (failed twice independently). Never quote the pooled headline without the stratum split. AND THE OPPONENT-DEFENCE TERM IS NOW THE PROGRAMME'S ONLY LIVE LEAD ON THE BETTING POPULATION - while remaining raised-not-accepted, 2024-dominated and not reproducing pooled. That is an uncomfortable place to be and is stated plainly.

head: 9950915c3c82a0945d0952c605a240991fb96791
detail: D110 CORRECTS D105. THE ASSERTION, READ FROM SOURCE, IS A CONSISTENCY CHECK: `n_dirty_paths == len(_dirty)`, comparing the repository's dirty-path count against a snapshot taken EARLIER IN THE SAME TEST RUN. The test runs 100-290 seconds. ANYTHING THAT WRITES TO THE REPO DURING THAT WINDOW FAILS IT, regardless of the tree being clean at push time. D105's MECHANISM WAS RIGHT and its specific cause was wrong. The gate failed three times for three reasons: six agents writing; those agents still writing; and finally - AFTER the coordinator verified a clean tree and zero processes - BECAUSE IT DISPATCHED A NEW AGENT MOMENTS BEFORE PUSHING. THE CONSTRAINT NOT PREVIOUSLY GRASPED: THE GATE NEEDS A QUIET WINDOW OF MINUTES, NOT A CLEAN INSTANT. An empty `git status` is necessary and not sufficient. THIRD WRONG DIAGNOSIS OF THE SAME FAILURE. Attempt one: a worktree/hook GIT_DIR artifact, stated to the user as a strong suspicion, refuted by a standalone run. Attempt two: the dirty commit, refuted by a clean-tree failure. ONLY ON THE THIRD DID THE COORDINATOR READ THE FOUR-LINE ASSERTION THAT WAS AVAILABLE THE WHOLE TIME. AND A SECOND ERROR: the coordinator told the user the background push 'completed with exit 0'. IT HAD NOT - the exit code came from the last command in a chain, not from git, and six commits remained unpushed. PUSHES ARE VERIFIED BY HEAD COMPARISON ONLY. All three diagnoses shared a shape: each proposed an INTERESTING mechanism when the actual cause was the coordinator repeatedly doing the same simple thing wrong. It applied a check-don't-infer standard to every agent's work today and not to its own operations.

head: e461539cc6ef169333b0717b86192883f8ef8d4b
detail: E1_I0033_aggregation_level RETURNED, CLOSED. Decision D111. THE USER'S ARCHITECTURAL HYPOTHESIS IS VALIDATED WITH A MECHANISM. TEAM LEVEL WINS FOR TEAM POINTS BY 9.578 MAE (8.686 vs 18.263), p < 0.0001. AND THE CHAMPION'S SUMMED PLAYER FORECAST CORRELATES +0.0013 WITH TEAM POINTS - ESSENTIALLY ZERO. But the team arm ALSO loses to a tuned team average (-2.42%), so both levels lose to simple baselines - D094 reproduced one level up. THE DECOMPOSITION FOUND A NEW STRUCTURAL DEFECT, 81.7% of the gap: the forecast universe averages 14.428 rows per team-game against a REALISED roster of 9.402, and the availability forecast SUMS TO 10.338. Tier-B fallback rows carry p_active 0.52 against a realised appearance rate of 0.10 - one phantom player at ~8.7 points is +8.14 POINTS OF LEVEL BIAS. THE AVAILABILITY MODEL IS CALIBRATED ONE PLAYER AT A TIME AND NOBODY CHECKED THAT IT ADDS UP TO A TEAM, BECAUSE NOBODY HAD EVER SUMMED IT. D090's per-player assessment was correct; the defect is only visible in aggregate. TWO COORDINATOR HYPOTHESES REFUTED: error compounding does the OPPOSITE - 52.0 points of per-player error COLLAPSE to 10.5 when summed (ratio 0.674 against independence), because points are a near-fixed team budget and errors cancel. And player forecasts are only marginally weaker (-2.82% vs -2.42%). THE GENERAL MECHANISM, WHICH IS THE MOST VALUABLE OUTPUT: team wins six of six quantities, BUT THE PENALTY RUNS 49.6% TO 6.6%, A FACTOR OF 7.5 - attempts 49.6%, points 27.3%, rebounds 15.7%, assists 11.0%, FT attempts 7.3%, FT makes 6.6%. THE RULE: INDIVIDUAL ACTS SURVIVE AGGREGATION FROM BELOW; ALLOCATIONS OF A SHARED FIXED BUDGET DO NOT. A free throw is one player alone at the line; shot attempts come out of 200 shared minutes and a possession count identical for both teams in 970/970 games, and modelling players separately DISCARDS THAT CONSTRAINT. THE USER'S FOUL-SHOT EXAMPLE QUANTIFIED: team FT% runs 74.23% to 83.98%, so the same +1.087 attempts is worth 0.8068 vs 0.9129 points - a spread of 0.1061 per game, 11.0% of the home advantage. REAL, CALCULABLE, NOT ACTIONABLE: 526x below the detection floor, and NOT ESTABLISHED rather than absent. THE PLAYER-VALUE PREMISE CORRECTED: the naive absence estimator is WRONG BY ~35x. A pre-game top-three absence worth 15.815 naive points produces a realised shortfall of 0.085 - beta +0.0284, and beta=1.0 is 22.3 null sd away, DECISIVELY REJECTED on a POWERED interval. SUBSTITUTION IS ESSENTIALLY COMPLETE FOR TOTALS. But it relocates rather than kills player-value modelling: when a starter sits the team scores the same BUT DIFFERENT PEOPLE SCORE THEM, and that redistribution is invisible at team level and IS THE WHOLE CONTENT OF A PROPS BOOK. THE HOLISTIC OWNS THE TOTAL; THE GRANULAR OWNS THE ALLOCATION. HONESTY AGAINST ITS OWN HEADLINE: a fully repaired bottom-up TIES the team arm (p 0.7295) - and the agent explained why that does not rescue it, since the repaired version reaches parity by shrinking to a near-constant (slope 0.07-0.15 against 0.33-0.99), i.e. by ceasing to be bottom-up. DISCIPLINE: five post-hoc additions, ALL FIVE MAKING THE PLAYER SIDE LOOK BETTER; power verified by injection per cell with type-I 0.0425 over 400 synthetic datasets; and THE AGENT APPLIED D108 PROSPECTIVELY - the cyclic null is used nowhere because every candidate varies at team or between-team level. RULING: aggregation level is now a first-class design variable that every screen must state. SOME RECORDED NULLS MAY BE LEVEL ARTEFACTS - a second independent reason the negative record is weaker evidence than it looked.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0035_availability_sum RETURNED. Decisions D112 and D113. REPRODUCTION EXACT BY AN INDEPENDENT PATH: every E1_I0033 number reproduced, both MAE figures IDENTICAL TO SIX DECIMAL PLACES, identity map recomputed from 519,920 triples and exact on all 22,659 rows. Two independent implementations agreeing to 6 dp is the strongest verification this programme has produced. ONE CORRECTION TO E1_I0033's RETELLING: it says tier-B rows receive a declared 0.80; ONLY 43.1% DO - the rest carry a FITTED value averaging 0.3167 against a realised 0.0172. Its own NOTES.md is correct; the error is in the retelling. No number and no conclusion of its changes. THE MECHANISM IS TWO DEFECTS, NOT ONE. (a) 73%: cbs_generator.py:71 declares p_active = 0.800 and cbs_v7.py:1341 DISCARDS THE FITTED OUTPUT on every nonzero fallback level. The value is NEITHER LEARNED NOR DERIVED - the registry's derivations dict lacks the key - AND THE SCOPE IS UNAUTHORISED: documents confine declared constants to level 4 and level 1, nothing authorises the level-2/3 substitution on fitted seasons, and the regression test covers only the 2021 path. (b) 49%: the arm trains on TIER A ONLY (base rate 0.779) and scores TIER B (base rate 0.102) - AND THE CONTRACT LABELS THOSE ROWS UNVERIFIED WHILE THE ARM NEVER READS THE LABEL. D090 RECONCILED WITH A GENERAL LESSON: AUC IS INVARIANT TO MONOTONE TRANSFORMS AND A SUM IS NOT - adding the broken rows makes AUC RISE (0.8979 to 0.9026) while mean p sits 0.065 above base rate. A DISCRIMINATION METRIC CANNOT DETECT A LEVEL DEFECT BY CONSTRUCTION. D090 also physically could not see the rows (3,808 excluded for a missing manifest; its constant probe counted 18 rows against 2,239) - D087 reference incompleteness INSIDE a defect probe. THE POPULATION IS STALENESS, NOT DEEP BENCH: 83.8% of tier-B rows are pairings that NEVER MATERIALISE; 69.9% last played IN A PRIOR SEASON; 23.4% played within 7 days FOR A DIFFERENT CLUB with a realised rate for this club of 0.0068 - SIX ROWS OUT OF 882. THE LARGEST CONTRIBUTORS ARE ESTABLISHED STARTERS HELD AGAINST CLUBS THEY LEFT. A data-freshness defect wearing a calibration costume; the coordinator's 'deep bench' description to the user pointed at the wrong repair. REPAIRS: Xa (per-tier recalibration) is THE ONLY option passing both levels (Brier 0.130 to 0.095, AUC 0.903 to 0.929, tier B 0.291 to 0.100). Xb is the predicted trap - best team number, ESTABLISHED HARM to 16,312 well-calibrated tier-A rows, and a downstream effect IDENTICAL TO DOING NOTHING because exposure renormalises. Xc established harm plus 5.23% coverage loss. Xd EMITS A CONSTANT (slopes 0.000/-0.016/-0.021). NONE ENACTED. IT DOES NOT REACH PRODUCTION: zero p_active references in any shipped component; the per-player forecast is CONDITIONAL ON PLAYING with no P(active) term; the only multiply site is registered production_eligible: False. LOW live urgency, HIGH as a gate on bottom-up or exposure promotion. D113 - A METHODOLOGICAL ALARM RAISED FROM A FOOTNOTE: the agent reports THE PROGRAMME'S ANALYTIC MDE80 IS ANTI-CONSERVATIVE BY 6.6x ON THE PLAYER CELL because null_sd is computed from an EFFECT-CARRYING vector. IF GENERAL, THIS RUNS IN THE WORST DIRECTION - cells would look better powered than they are, meaning D103's finding that 56.3% of cells were blind would be UNDERSTATED. NOT VERIFIED, NOTHING REVISED, AN AUDIT IS COMMISSIONED, and injection-verified floors outrank analytic ones until it reports. NEW INVARIANT: AUC IS NEVER SUFFICIENT FOR A FORECAST THAT WILL BE SUMMED.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0036_level_artefact_sweep RETURNED. Decisions D114 and D115. THE LEVEL-ARTEFACT HYPOTHESIS IS CLOSED NEGATIVE, WITH AN ARITHMETIC REASON: TEAM LEVEL RAISES THE DETECTION FLOOR 8.3x-9.3x (MDE 4.24e-04 to 3.5e-03) AGAINST A DILUTION GAIN OF ~9.4x - THE TWO NEARLY CANCEL. And decisively: THE PROGRAMME'S LARGEST LIVE EFFECT SITS ENTIRELY BELOW THE TEAM-LEVEL DETECTION FLOOR. Re-levelling is not a rescue strategy at this sample size. THE CENSUS BOUNDED THE HYPOTHESIS BEFORE ANY STATISTIC: 1,999 cells, 1,580 kills, and ONLY 118 (7.5%) WERE EVER ELIGIBLE FOR RE-LEVELLING - 591 at player/row level where it cannot help, 436 with no recorded level, ruled ineligible rather than guessed. NOT ONE OF THE 213 CEILING KILLS WAS RESURRECTED. RE-RUNS: NO SURVIVOR. One cell clears at p=0.0498 under one reference and 0.0532 under another - THE VERDICT FLIPS ON THE REFERENCE. Adding the opponent's own prior allowed total shrank increments 2.2x-8.3x: D087 REFERENCE INCOMPLETENESS CAUGHT LIVE. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION OF D103: 51.1% of killed cells blind to the programme's best live effect, on a differently assembled census. 381 cells corrected from 'powered-null' to 'POWER-NEVER-ASSESSED'. D097's REBOUND KILL IS REVERSED - AND THE CAUSE WAS THE NULL, NOT THE LEVEL. Anchor reproduced exactly (0.0064881160, n=13,784). 98.19% OF R08's MEASURED EFFECT IS BETWEEN PLAYERS. N_CYCLIC PASSED ITS PREREGISTERED INJECTION AT POWER 0.95 AND HAS POWER 0.00 AGAINST A BETWEEN-PLAYER SIGNAL. AND IT ANNOUNCED ITSELF: NULL MEAN 7.90e-03 EXCEEDS OBSERVED 6.49e-03 - THE NULL CONTAINED THE EFFECT RATHER THAN EXCLUDING IT. Under the matched player-swap null: p=0.001661 pooled, p=0.003322 on the decision stratum. COUNTERWEIGHT: shrinks 5.7x into the decision stratum to 0.001146, which is 0.49x the 132-cell floor; family not recomputed; in-sample. A LEAD, NOT A CHAMPION - the agent said so itself. SCOREBOARD ON THE NEGATIVE RECORD: against LEVEL it SURVIVES; against POWER unchanged and corroborated; AGAINST NULLS IT DOES NOT SURVIVE. D115 - THE FAILURE MODE IS GENERAL: ANY NULL PERMUTING WITHIN AN ENTITY IS BLIND TO A BETWEEN-ENTITY CANDIDATE, AND ANNOUNCES ITSELF BY null_mean > observed. 550 KILLED CELLS SIT AT EXPOSED LEVELS AND HAVE NEVER BEEN AUDITED. THE AUDIT IS A QUERY AGAINST ALREADY-RECORDED COLUMNS - no refitting, no new data - and is the cheapest high-value work available. COMMISSIONED IMMEDIATELY. AND A SEVERITY-A DEFECT IN THE FIX THE COORDINATOR ADOPTED TWO HOURS AGO: D108's OWN INJECTION PROTOCOL CAN CERTIFY A NULL THAT IS BLIND TO THE REAL CANDIDATE, because shuffling residuals destroys the response structure the null fails to destroy in the carrier. N_CYCLIC IS THE PROOF - certified at power 0.95, actual power 0.00. The coordinator adopted injection verification as the programme's guarantee against degenerate nulls and BRIEFED FOUR SCREENS ON IT AS A REQUIREMENT. Amendment: inject COMPONENT-WISE and flag null_mean > observed unconditionally. THE VERIFICATION MACHINERY HAS NOW FAILED AT THREE LEVELS IN ONE DAY - a defective null, a defective injection check certifying that null, and a possibly anti-conservative power floor (D113) above both. POSTURE: NO METHODOLOGICAL GUARANTEE IN THIS PROGRAMME SHOULD BE TRUSTED UNTIL ATTACKED BY SOMEONE WHO DID NOT BUILD IT.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0034_redistribution RETURNED. Decision D116. THE FIRST OPERATIONALLY ACTIONABLE FINDING OF THE PROGRAMME. REDISTRIBUTION IS REAL, HAS A THRESHOLD, IS UNFORECASTABLE IN ITS ALLOCATION, AND REACHES MINUTES BUT NOT POINTS. THE THRESHOLD IS THE MECHANISM: BELOW ~30 MINUTES OF ABSENCE THERE IS NOTHING TO REDISTRIBUTE - the remaining players' own trailing-5 baselines ALREADY SUM TO 200 (198.96 / 201.08 / 201.50) and the realised gain is NEGATIVE in all three strata. Above it, slack opens and gain tracks it NEAR ONE-FOR-ONE: +8.6 slack against +6.36 realised, +16.0 against +15.47. THE ROTATION ABSORBS SMALL ABSENCES WITHOUT MOVING. No leakage to call-ups (theta -0.030; full leakage rejected at 59.6 null sd with the null verified able to see theta=1). WHO BENEFITS: NOBODY PREDICTABLY. No pre-game predictor explains more than 1.5% of within-team-game variation against a spread of +/- 6 minutes. All three tilt cells NOT ESTABLISHED. FORECAST VALUE on 2,475 rows with >=25 min freed: MINUTES +1.82% (p 0.0003); POINTS -1.17%, i.e. WORSE (p 0.0008). COUNTERWEIGHTS PUBLISHED AGAINST ITSELF: the headline sits ON its power boundary (empirical power 0.783, agent DOWNGRADED IT); D111's ATTEMPTS PREDICTION IS FALSIFIED - the apparent +0.0074 gain comes ENTIRELY from FREED=0 rows WHERE THE TREATMENT IS IDENTICALLY ZERO and reverses sign where treatment is strongest, a vacuous-control instance the agent caught itself; THE ABSORPTION TELL FIRED IN PRODUCTION ON ITS FIRST OUTING (null mean -0.0232 vs observed -0.0349, 67% absorbed) - the diagnostic adopted six hours ago caught a live partially-absorbing null; and a secondary window FLIPS THE TILT SIGN, making 'diffuse' a not-established verdict on an unstable statistic. VERIFICATION - THE BEST THE PROGRAMME HAS SEEN. BLINDNESS DEMONSTRATED, NOT ARGUED: a planted between-player effect at 4 null sd is detected by the matched player swap at p=0.0017 and the cyclic shift returns p=0.8087 - E1_I0036 REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY ON THIS SCREEN'S OWN CANDIDATE. Levels MEASURED not asserted (95-96% between-player). D-04 CONFIRMED EMPIRICALLY: the shuffled-residual injection SYSTEMATICALLY ATTENUATES the recovered effect, 0.024 to -0.001 at 2 null sd. Anchors reproduced exactly INCLUDING six figures of a sibling screen's construction. No-op placebo EXACTLY 0.0. head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0037_mde_audit RETURNED. D103 SURVIVES INTACT: 760 to 766 blind, 56.34% to 56.78%, +0.44pp IN THE DIRECTION IT ALREADY POINTED. Only 30 cells (2.2%) affected, 24 already counted blind. Anchor reproduced to SIXTEEN DIGITS. A LARGER EXPOSURE FOUND AND NOT QUANTIFIED: **D103's t_statistic family - 666 OF 1,349 CELLS CARRYING 518 OF THE 760 BLIND VERDICTS (68%) - USES A SCALE CONVERSION THAT NEVER PASSED D103's OWN VALIDATION GATE**, whose validate() reads a file containing only increment cells. Census also shows 666 figures on UNVALIDATED permutation nulls against 1,189 validated. NOW THE LARGEST UNQUANTIFIED EXPOSURE; commissioned as the next power screen. THE COORDINATOR'S DIAGNOSTIC IS CORRECTED A SECOND TIME BY A SECOND AGENT: null_mean > observed IS STRUCTURALLY VACUOUS ON SIGN-FLIP NULLS because draws are +/- a fixed set of block sums, so E[draws] = 0 EXACTLY BY CONSTRUCTION. A COVERAGE GAP, NOT A CLEAN BILL OF HEALTH. Combined with D117's PPV 0.146 finding, THE DIAGNOSTIC HAS NOW BEEN CORRECTED TWICE BY TWO AGENTS FOR TWO UNRELATED REASONS - it was adopted programme-wide within an hour on one screen's evidence. RULINGS: D113 CLOSED REFUTED; a SIX-BLOCK HARD FLOOR adopted - no cell may be reported as a null below it; t_crit must be checked against sqrt(nb) BEFORE applying any family-wise correction; the t_statistic family is the next priority; the coordinator's diagnostic is LIMITED to permutation nulls with a non-degenerate centre; no fix applied to the shared kit.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0039_stacking RETURNED. Decision D119. THE USER'S AGGREGATION INSTRUCTION IS ANSWERED. Order of application moves ABC by 19-22%. Twelve of forty verdicts change with the power-floor choice; both columns published. WHAT HELD: D116 reproduced independently (-1.15% points harm vs published -1.17%), and the threshold has teeth BOTH WAYS - below it the treatment is ACTIVELY HARMFUL on minutes at p 0.0003. SEVENTEEN anchors reproduced, SIXTEEN at exactly 0.000e+00 including one to 5.1e-16 - AND THAT DISCIPLINE CAUGHT TWO REAL DEFECTS, one of which made C look like a -0.70 MAE disaster. RULINGS: THE USER'S PRINCIPLE IS VINDICATED (disjoint components aggregate at 98% of the arithmetic sum) AND THE PORTFOLIO IS WRONG - select future work by WHERE IT LANDS, not by pooled size. Every screen must report its decision-stratum intersection FIRST. The cold-start and fallback recommendations are DOWNGRADED to model hygiene, not commercially actionable - THE COORDINATOR PRESENTED THEM OTHERWISE AND CORRECTS IT. Redistribution is the only live candidate and needs a second clean window.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c

FROZEN-INTERCEPT +0.0796 MAE = +1.774%, p 0.0030 - IT GROWS UNDER A TRUE FREEZE**, unlike cold-start and fallback routing which both went to EXACTLY 0.0000. The effect never changes sign, and the UNGATED arm BEATS ALL ELEVEN GATES (+0.0414 vs +0.0360 at the published cutoff). THE GATE COSTS 13% OF THE GAIN.** RECOMMENDATION REVERSED: apply it always. THE DISTINCTION THE COORDINATOR MISSED: **THE MECHANISM THRESHOLD IS REAL AND REPRODUCES ON 20 OF 20 FIGURES** - rotations do absorb absences below ~30 minutes. **THAT IS A TRUE FACT ABOUT BASKETBALL AND IT DOES NOT IMPLY A GATING RULE FOR A FORECAST.** The coordinator read a mechanism straight across into a prescription without testing the prescription. A MECHANISM THRESHOLD AND A DECISION THRESHOLD ARE DIFFERENT OBJECTS. A GENERAL DEFECT TOUCHING EVERY LATTICE: swapping A and B into the stack is 'worth' +0.0287 at p 0.00005 ON ROWS WHERE THEY SUBSTITUTE NOTHING - above both floors, 36% of C's real effect, PURE INTERCEPT MOVEMENT. EVERY SHARED-INTERCEPT LATTICE IS EXPOSED, and no column-level check can see it. HELD: even allocation upheld, published tilt term is a DRAG, minutes-yes/points-no boundary HOLDS AND HARDENS. DID NOT: C alone is ORDER-SENSITIVE at 36.3% spread. AGENT CONDUCT: two of its own instruments broken first, BOTH CORRECTIONS RUNNING AGAINST ITS OWN HEADLINE (power 0.79 to 0.482). 43 anchors reproduced, 40 at exactly 0.000e+00, ZERO mismatches. RULINGS: gating recommendation REVERSED; harm-below-threshold WITHDRAWN; C is the only non-artefactual candidate AND is not established - both halves always stated together; MECHANISM THRESHOLDS DO NOT IMPLY DECISION THRESHOLDS; every lattice must report a frozen-intercept arm; ONE CLEAN WINDOW IS A STRUCTURAL LIMIT OF THE PROGRAMME.

head: 1d31d19695d91a8ca33ca786b4dcced7d0e8ca0c
detail: E1_I0041_tstat_family_audit RETURNED. Decision D122. THE POWER-METHODOLOGY ARC IS CLOSED. **THE CONVERSION EQUATION IS SOUND** - the scale identity holds on 330 real cells at a median ratio of 1.0000, and given honest inputs the formula reproduces an injection-verified floor at 0.989 across 96 clustered/unbalanced/AR(1) conditions. Call sites AST-RESOLVED over 1,104 files, not grepped. **THE DEFECTS ARE IN THE INPUTS AND RUN IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS.** C1 (348 cells): sd_null_t is the sd of |t| - np.abs at the storage site, all 18 arrays with frac_negative EXACTLY 0.0000 - narrowing the sd by 1.79x and making floors 2.79x TOO SMALL. C2 (all 666): t_crit is the standardised max of a dR2 statistic APPLIED TO A t; the correct bar is 3.795/3.773 sd, making floors 2.85x TOO LARGE. **FOR THE LARGEST GROUP THEY CANCEL TO 1.6% ON THE BAR.** Two serious errors in opposite directions leaving the biggest group nearly correct - which is why no single-direction alarm could have found it. **C3 IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: 67 CELLS HAVE A DEGENERATE PERMUTATION NULL AND 6 MORE HAVE sd EXACTLY 0, FOR WHICH THE FORMULA RETURNS A DETECTION FLOOR OF EXACTLY 0.0** - asserting the cell could detect any effect however small. **35 OF THESE 73 ARE RECORDED BY D103 AS ADEQUATELY POWERED.** THE GATE GAP IS CONFIRMED: validate() reads a 216-row file with no stat_family column whose statistic is dR2, and NO OTHER VALIDATION OF mde80_tscale EXISTS ANYWHERE. **D103 IS RESTATED AS AN INTERVAL.** Anchor reproduced to sixteen digits; independent reconstruction agrees to 1.07e-13. Published 760 blind (56.34%); R-A 886 (65.68%, +9.34pp); R-B 908 (67.31%); R-C, Sidak, 613 (45.44%, MINUS 10.90pp). The defended correction is TWENTY-ONE TIMES E1_I0037's +0.44pp AND R-C REVERSES THE SIGN BY NEARLY AS MUCH. **HONEST READING: 45% TO 67%, NOT 56.3% TO TWO DECIMALS - CONVENTION-SENSITIVE BY +/- 11 POINTS. EVERY VERSION PRESERVES THE QUALITATIVE CONCLUSION.** The finding is robust; the number never was. THE STRUCTURAL GATES DO NOT TRANSFER, AND THE AGENT PROVED IT RATHER THAN ASSUMING: 0 of 666 below six blocks; 102 with t_crit >= sqrt(nb), all E0_I0014's 36-block cells - but the null's sd is FLAT in the planted effect (1.0001), which is the condition gate B requires, and p_min here is 1/1001 not 2^(1-nb). THE 102 IS ARITHMETIC, NOT A FINDING. The coordinator suggested these gates might dominate; the agent checked, said they do not, and named what does. AGENT CONDUCT: first simulation degenerate (zero power in 192/192), caught by its own PRE-COMMITTED check, defective output PRESERVED not overwritten. Family-wise Type-I check mis-specified, replacement NOT ESTIMABLE, flagged rather than answered badly. **PROPOSED FIX PASSES 13/13 TESTS AND IS EXPLICITLY NOT RECOMMENDED** - worse in two named regimes. THE THIRD AGENT TODAY TO PROPOSE A FIX, MEASURE IT, FIND IT WORSE, AND DECLINE TO RECOMMEND IT. RULINGS: D103's headline is RESTATED AS 45-67% and may never again be quoted as 56.3%; the 73 non-functioning nulls are reclassified UNVERIFIABLE; store SIGNED statistics never absolute values; a critical value must be derived on the scale it is applied to (D101 inside a power calculation); no fix applied; THE POWER ARC IS CLOSED.

COMMISSIONED FOR TEST. ALSO: E1_I0023's disclosed ceiling noise floor is UNDERSTATED 11x on exactly the cell D098 headlined; and D103's stated reason its sighting was new is FALSE - D085 did screen the A-family against ppm. RULINGS: corroboration claim WITHDRAWN; candidate is an E0 lead and NOT a forecasting signal; SHARED-INPUT AUDITS MANDATORY before any corroboration claim; the ceiling statistic must be tested as a bound; the null-centre check is PROMOTED - it worked where the coordinator's own diagnostic failed three times.

head: b0530973016d64fc367086e93147330735298e20
